papers.title: Improving Healthcare Utilization in Retired Self-Employed Workers: Evidence From an Experiment in France.
papers.abstract: This study examines the impact of a program designed to address the non-take-up of social benefits on healthcare utilization among targeted at-risk formerly self-employed workers in France. We test two main hypotheses: first, that sending a self-assessment questionnaire to the treated group can increase healthcare use; second, that personalized assistance from a social worker can enhance this effect. Utilizing a quasi-experimental framework (2014-2016) and synthetic difference-in-differences models to address selective entry into the various treatments, our results reveal that proactive information outreach alone increased healthcare utilization by 0.6%, while the combined approach with personalized assistance amplified this effect to 2%. In all configurations, access to services and healthcare consumption improved, while care pathways shifted, potentially toward preventive and early-stage treatments. Our findings support the use of multiple uptake strategies, such as targeting, proactive outreach, and tailored integrated benefit packages, in overcoming barriers to healthcare.
papers.summary: 本研究探討法國針對退休自僱勞工設計的社會福利申請促進計畫，對其醫療保健利用率的影響。透過2014至2016年的準實驗框架與合成雙重差分模型，研究發現，單純主動發送自我評估問卷能使醫療利用率提升0.6%，若結合社工的個人化協助，則能將成效進一步放大至2%。此外，該計畫不僅改善了醫療服務的可及性與消費量，亦使照護路徑產生轉移，可能朝向預防性及早期治療發展。
papers.significance: 此研究為解決弱勢群體「未領取社會福利」問題提供了實證支持，證實了「目標鎖定、主動外展與個人化協助」等多管齊下的策略能有效打破醫療利用障礙。這對各國政府在設計公共衛生政策與社會安全網時，如何以精準介入方式提升高風險自僱者的醫療預防與早期治療，具有重要的政策參考價值。

papers.title: Further Findings on the Intergenerational Transmission of Alcohol Consumption.
papers.abstract: Using 43,817 parent-child pairs from 23 waves of the HILDA Survey, I study the intergenerational transmission of alcohol use within a rational model of trait transmission. Transmission is predominantly same-sex: the mother-daughter elasticity is 0.10 and the father-son elasticity is 0.09; there is no father-daughter effect. Influence peaks at ages 15-17 and re-emerges at 28-37 when offspring become parents; mothers also affect sons at both junctures. Comparisons with non-birth (adoptee-style) dyads show similar mother-daughter transmission, indicating norm-based rather than biological channels. Identification concerns are addressed with placebo reshuffling and copula-based corrections; estimates are robust across specifications. Men who remain childless are more likely to mirror maternal drinking, which-together with declining fertility and earlier alcohol-control policies-helps explain cohort declines in male drinking. The interpretation is that parental norms anchor behavior at identity-forming and role-transition ages, with strong persistence thereafter. Policy should target these windows with gender-specific, couple-level interventions alongside population levers on price, availability and marketing.
papers.summary: 本研究利用澳洲HILDA調查的43,817對親子數據，探討酒精消費的代際傳遞現象。研究發現，酒精消費傳遞主要以同性為主（母女彈性0.10，父子彈性0.09），且影響在子女15至17歲及28至37歲（成為父母時）達到高峰。透過非血緣（類收養）配對的比較，證實此傳遞機制基於社會規範而非生物遺傳。此外，無子女的男性更容易模仿母親的飲酒行為，這結合生育率下降與早期的酒精管制政策，共同解釋了男性飲酒率的世代下降趨勢。
papers.significance: 該研究突破了單純的生物遺傳視角，證實了父母規範在子女身份認同形成與角色轉換關鍵期的錨定效應，為理解跨世代健康行為的傳遞提供了堅實的實證基礎。其政策意涵在於，建議在上述特定年齡窗口實施針對性別與伴侶層級的精準干預措施，這不僅豐富了健康經濟學中的行為傳遞理論，也為制定更有效的公共健康政策提供了科學依據。

papers.title: Promoting Safe Opioid Disposal: Experimental Evidence on Behavioral Messaging With Financial Incentives.
papers.abstract: Some patients prescribed opioid pills fail to properly dispose of their unused pills, posing a risk for others. We report results from a pre-registered field experiment testing whether behaviorally informed reminder cards increase participation in a financial incentive program for returning unused opioid pills among U.S. Veterans. The cards incorporate principles from behavioral economics, including timely reminders, implementation intention prompts, and loss framing. Relative to a cash incentive alone, the reminder cards increase both the likelihood that patients return unused pills (the extensive margin) and the number of pills returned (the intensive margin). The intervention also improves cost-effectiveness, reducing both the cost per pill returned and the cost per participant who returns pills. These findings show that low-cost behavioral messaging can meaningfully enhance the effectiveness of existing financial incentive programs for safe opioid disposal.
papers.summary: 本研究透過實地實驗探討行為經濟學訊息（如適時提醒、執行意圖提示與損失框架）對美國退伍軍人退回未使用阿片類藥物的影響。結果顯示，相較於單純提供現金激勵，加入行為科學提醒卡不僅能提升患者退回藥物的比例（廣延邊際），亦能增加退回的藥物數量（集約邊際），進而大幅改善該計畫的整體成本效益。
papers.significance: 此研究證實低成本的行為訊息干預能顯著強化現有財務激勵政策的執行成效，為解決阿片類藥物誤用與濫用的公共衛生危機提供具高成本效益的實務方案，對未來醫療體系推動安全用藥與廢棄藥物管理政策具備重要參考價值。

papers.title: The Impact of Unemployment Insurance Benefit Cuts on Mental Health: Evidence From Early Pandemic Program Expirations.
papers.abstract: This study is the first to estimate the effects of unemployment insurance (UI) benefit contractions on mental health. We leverage a unique quasi-natural experiment: early termination of the Federal Pandemic Unemployment Compensation (FPUC) and Pandemic Unemployment Assistance (PUA) programs across more than 20 states during the summer of 2021. Using high-frequency data from the Census Bureau's Household Pulse Survey (HPS), our difference-in-differences estimates suggest that early withdrawal from FPUC and PUA increases the probability of reporting anxiety symptoms among working-age adults without a college degree, a group particularly vulnerable to unexpected income shocks. The adverse effects are more pronounced among racial and ethnic minorities, older individuals, and women. However, the increase in anxiety symptoms is short-lived, persisting for about 1 month after the benefit cessation. Finally, we find evidence that financial hardship is a likely mechanism underlying these findings.
papers.summary: 本研究首度估計了失業保險（UI）福利縮減對心理健康的影響。研究利用2021年夏季美國逾20個州提前終止聯邦大流行失業補償（FPUC）和流行病失業援助（PUA）計畫的準自然實驗，透過雙重差分法分析高頻調查數據。結果顯示，提前取消這些福利會顯著增加無大學學歷勞動年齡成人出現焦慮症狀的機率，且在少數族裔、老年人及女性中影響更為明顯。然而，此焦慮症狀的增加是短暫的，約在福利停發一個月後消退，而經濟困難是導致這些影響的潛在機制。
papers.significance: 此研究填補了失業保險政策評估中對心理健康影響的文獻空白，證實了UI福利削減對弱勢勞工群體的心理健康會產生實質的短期負面衝擊。這項發現對政策制定者具有重要啟示，表明在設計或終止緊急失業救濟政策時，必須將潛在的心理健康代價與財務壓力機制納入考量，以避免對弱勢群體造成不成比例的傷害。

papers.title: Cost savings of task-sharing in family planning: estimates across 128 low- and middle-income countries.
papers.abstract: Task-sharing, the expansion of health service provision to a broader range of health workers, where the number of providers is expanded through training and support of additional cadres, offers a strategy to alleviate some of the human resource and financial challenges that limit low- and middle-income countries' (LMICs) ability to deliver essential health services, including family planning (FP). In this study, we apply the World Health Organization's (WHO) recommendations to estimate the potential cost-savings from task-sharing FP services. We use the Adding It Up (AIU) 2024 model estimates on contraceptive services for 128 LMICs to estimate the direct costs of providing contraceptive care for six methods - condoms (male and female), oral contraceptive pills, emergency contraceptive pills (ECP), injectables, implants and intrauterine devices. We compare the costs of two scenarios - a status quo (under current provider guidelines for FP service delivery) and a task-sharing scenario (implementing WHO task-sharing guidelines for FP service delivery). Implementing WHO task-sharing recommendations within the next year would save an estimated $1.6 billion USD across all LMICs. Task-sharing reduces the direct cost of service delivery for all six methods, saving 34% for male condoms, 31% for injectables, 30% for pills and IUDs, 22% for ECPs, 12% for implants and 9% for female condoms. These cost savings were largely consistent at the global, regional, and sub-regional levels. WHO recommendations for task-sharing service delivery offer a critical cost-saving policy mechanism that leverages limited human and financial resources to better meet contraceptive needs while at the same time reducing health system costs. Cost estimates generated from the AIU model show that implementing WHO recommendations for task-sharing family planning services is a promising strategy for expanding access to contraceptive care across LMICs. Amidst increasing cuts to family planning financing, strategies for delivering quality services at lower costs are critical to ensuring continued access to care. Not applicable.
papers.summary: 本研究運用世界衛生組織（WHO）的建議與2024年Adding It Up模型，針對128個低中收入國家估算實施計劃生育「任務分擔」（task-sharing，即培訓並擴大基層醫療人員提供服務的範圍）的成本節約效果。研究比較現行服務模式與任務分擔模式在提供六種避孕方法上的直接成本差異。結果顯示，若全面落實WHO任務分擔指南，全球低中收入國家一年內可節約約16億美元成本，各項避孕方法的直接服務成本降幅介於9%至34%之間，且此節約效應在全球、區域及次區域層面皆保持一致。
papers.classification: 健康經濟學與成本分析
papers.significance: 在面臨全球計劃生育資金持續削減的挑戰下，本研究提供了強有力的量化證據，證實任務分擔是一項具備高成本效益的政策工具。這不僅能有效減輕低中收入國家醫療體系的人力和財務負擔，更確保了在資源受限的環境中，民眾仍能持續獲得可負擔的避孕服務，對推動全球生殖健康與醫療資源優化配置具有極高的實務參考價值。

papers.title: Use of general practitioner services among high-cost older patients in somatic hospitals - a Norwegian registry-based study.
papers.abstract: General practitioners (GP) play a vital role in ensuring comprehensive and integrated healthcare to older adults with substantial use of somatic hospitals services. These patients, often referred to as high-cost older patients, use a substantial proportion of specialized healthcare resources, but less is known about their use of primary care and GP services. This study aims to explore the frequency of the use of GP services among high-cost older patients and other older patients admitted to Norwegian somatic hospitals and identify characteristics associated with the frequency of service use. This is an observational cross-sectional study using registry data of older Norwegian patients (≥65 years) with ≥1 unplanned contact with somatic hospitals in 2019 (n = 212,022). We used a negative binomial regression model to analyze the frequency of use of GP services and associations with patient characteristics. GP services include all contact types (consultations, home visits, interprofessional contacts, brief contacts, and administrative contacts). Both adjusted and unadjusted results were reported to provide a comprehensive understanding of the data. The high-cost group was defined as patients with the 10% highest diagnosis-related-group weights. A total of 183,847 patients, consisting of 18,440 high-cost and 165,407 non-high-cost older patients were included in the regression analysis. The unadjusted average frequency of GP contacts was 24.4 for the high-cost group and 16.6 for the non-high-cost group. After adjusting for the different characteristics in the two groups, the high-cost group still had a higher frequency of GP contacts compared to the non-high-cost older group. Several characteristics were associated with higher expected frequency of GP contacts, including older age, being female, and having multiple main diagnoses, multiple contacts with out-of-hours services, and/or longer hospital stay. The high-cost group had higher utilization of GP services across various contact types compared to other older adults. The healthcare utilization of high-cost older patients appears to transcend the context of somatic hospitals, as they could be deemed frequent users of GP services. Additionally, the association between GP service use and patient characteristics might indicate that groups known to have higher healthcare needs also use more services.
papers.summary: 本研究利用2019年挪威登記資料，探討高成本（DRG權重前10%）老年住院患者與其他老年患者使用全科醫生（GP）服務的頻率差異。結果顯示，高成本老年患者未調整的GP平均聯繫次數為24.4次，顯著高於非高成本組的16.6次；在控制患者特徵變項後，高成本組的GP服務使用頻率依然較高。此外，年齡較大、女性、多重主要診斷、多次使用夜間急診服務及住院時間較長等特徵，皆與更高的GP服務使用頻率顯著相關，且高成本組在各類型GP服務上的利用率皆高於其他老年患者。
papers.significance: 此研究揭示了高成本老年患者的醫療資源消耗並不侷限於專科醫院，他們同時也是基層醫療GP服務的頻繁使用者。這項發現對健康經濟與醫療政策制定具有重要意義，強調了在管理高耗用醫療資源的老年族群時，必須採取跨層級的整合性照護策略，以確保初級與專科醫療體系之間的有效銜接，進而優化整體醫療資源配置並提升照護品質。

papers.title: Community-engaged design of a virtual diabetes prevention program intervention with care coordination.
papers.abstract: The Diabetes Prevention Program (DPP) is an evidence-based approach to prevent Type 2 Diabetes (T2D), the leading cause of morbidity and mortality in the United States. Despite demonstrated benefits, acceptability and uptake of DPPs remain low, especially among communities with low incomes at increased risk for diabetes. The Yale-Griffin Prevention Research Center led the design of a community-engaged virtual DPP (vDPP) intervention and assessed its feasibility of implementation in two contrasting settings. The vDPP design followed an iterative, multi-partner mixed methods approach guided by a community-engaged research framework. The steps involved were: (1) application of the socio-ecological model theoretical framework to vDPP design (2) interviews and a technology survey with community residents and providers to assess feasibility (3) development of a program impact pathway (PIP) for ongoing process evaluation (4) five-week pilot study followed by participant focus groups, and (5) triage of findings to make necessary adaptations. This process led to a vDPP intervention that included an online platform with asynchronous programming and a health coach as well as an added care coordination component provided by local community health workers and hospital-based community nurses. Thematic analysis showed that community members and providers valued the concept of a structured program with personalized guidance and emphasized the importance of addressing social needs and considering broad health goals. The pilot study identified program facilitators and barriers around engagement, communication, and feelings of personal accountability that informed program adaptations made prior to full implementation testing, including clarification of support roles and addition of detailed orientation materials. This formative research demonstrated initial program feasibility and identified ways to improve the quality of program delivery. Pairing the PIP with a community-engaged approach led to the development of a novel health promotion intervention that is now being tested through a subsequent implementation science study. NCT04195477, clinicaltrials.gov, registered 7 October, 2020; https://www. gov/study/NCT04195477?term=NCT04195477&rank=1.
papers.summary: 本研究由耶魯-格里芬預防研究中心主導，採用社區參與式研究框架，設計並評估了一項虛擬糖尿病預防計畫的初步可行性。該計畫結合了線上異步平台、健康教練，並創新性地加入了由社區衛生員與醫院護士提供的照護協調服務。透過混合方法、五週試點研究及焦點團體，研究團隊發現目標群體重視具個人化指導的結構化計畫，並據此調整了支持角色與說明材料，以克服參與度與溝通上的障礙。
papers.significance: 此研究突破了傳統糖尿病預防計畫在低收入高風險社區中接受度低的困境，證實了結合「虛擬平台」與「實體社區照護協調」的新型干預模式具有高度可行性。其採用的專案影響路徑（PIP）與社區參與式設計不僅優化了服務交付品質，更為後續的實施科學研究奠定了堅實基礎，對提升弱勢群體的慢性病預防成效具有重要實踐參考價值。

papers.title: Health insurance coverage and health service utilisation in Uganda: an analysis of the 2016 Uganda Demographic and Health Survey.
papers.abstract: Health insurance is key in pooling resources for increased access to health services. There is currently no national health insurance scheme (NHIS) in Uganda and determining the profile of individuals with alternative health insurance can support future planning. The aim of this analysis was to explore the association between health insurance coverage and sociodemographic factors, health service utilisation and healthcare seeking behaviour in the 2016 Uganda Demographic and Health Survey (2016 UDHS). Descriptive statistics and bivariate Pearson's chi-square tests of association were conducted for 18,506 women and 5,336 men sampled in the 2016 UDHS. Significant variables at p < 0.05 informed the multivariable mixed effects Poisson regression analysis; this examined associations between health insurance coverage, sociodemographic factors, health service utilisation, and knowledge of insurance. Analyses were carried out using R Programming. Among the low proportion (1.4%) of individuals with health insurance, coverage widened with increasing wealth and education levels. Results of the regression analysis suggested a positive association between health service utilisation and being married, and increasing age, wealth, and knowledge of health insurance. Findings demonstrated a very low health insurance coverage among the 2016 UDHS. Adjusting for wealth and age, higher education levels were positively associated with coverage, indicating the importance of education in understanding health risk. Beyond an inclusive approach for vulnerable population groups, strategies for the NHIS need to incorporate sensitisation to stakeholders on the need for a personal health safety net. Further work on exploring how to ensure equity and financial risk protection in the NHIS implementation may be key to informal sector inclusion.
papers.summary: 本研究利用2016年烏干達人口與健康調查資料，分析健康保險覆蓋率與社會人口因素、醫療服務利用及就醫行為之間的關聯。研究顯示，烏干達的健康保險覆蓋率極低（僅1.4%），且隨著財富與教育水平的提高而增加。迴歸分析結果表明，已婚、年齡增長、財富較多以及具備健康保險知識與醫療服務的利用率呈正相關。
papers.significance: 本研究突顯了烏干達在缺乏全民健康保險制度下，醫療資源分配的顯著不平等問題，並證實了教育程度在理解健康風險與促進保險覆蓋中的關鍵作用。其結果對未來規劃全民健康保險制度具有重要參考價值，特別強調了必須採取包容性策略來保護弱勢群體，並透過利益相關者教育建立個人健康安全網，以確保非正式部門的公平性與財務風險保障。

papers.title: A generalized two-step floating building catchment area model for measuring EMS accessibility with in-building patient access.
papers.abstract: Rapid access to Emergency Medical Services (EMS) is critical for improving patient survival. Existing studies primarily assess EMS accessibility based on road travel, overlooking the in-building time required to reach patients, which may introduce bias in high-density urban environments. This study aims to improve the measurement of EMS accessibility by explicitly incorporating in-building patient access. We developed a generalized two-step floating building catchment area (G-2SFBCA) model that integrates both the Departure Road Trip (DRT) and the Patient Access Trip (PAT), while accounting for spatial variations in building height and occupancy density. Wuhan, China, was used as a case study. Building-level data, EMS station locations, and road network data were combined to estimate total EMS travel time. Accessibility was evaluated under different distance-decay functions and compared with results from the conventional G-2SFCA model. PAT travel time exhibited a distinct "low-high-low" spatial pattern from the city center to suburban areas, closely associated with variations in building height and density. Incorporating PAT reduced the population covered within a 5-minute EMS response time by 12.9% and increased the population outside the 12-minute threshold by 3.2%. Compared with the conventional model, the proposed approach revealed lower accessibility in transitional high-rise areas and highlighted the overestimation of EMS accessibility when in-building travel time is ignored. The proposed G-2SFBCA model provides a more realistic and policy-relevant assessment of EMS accessibility, revealing that conventional approaches may substantially overestimate service coverage in high-density urban environments.
papers.summary: 本研究針對高密度都市環境中緊急醫療服務（EMS）可及性評估的缺陷，提出了一種廣義的兩步浮動建築捕獲區域模型（G-2SFBCA）。該模型創新性地將「患者接駁行程」（PAT，即樓內尋找患者的時間）與傳統的「道路行程」（DRT）相結合，並納入建築高度與佔用密度的空間差異。以武漢市為例的實證結果顯示，傳統方法因忽略樓內時間，顯著高估了EMS的服務覆蓋率，而新模型能更真實地反映過渡性高層建築區域可及性較低的問題。
papers.significance: 此研究的貢獻在於打破了過去僅依賴道路網絡評估EMS可及性的盲區，證實了在都市化程度高的地區，樓內通行情節對急救效率的影響不容忽視。該模型不僅提升了空間評估的精確度，避免資源配置的錯誤預期，更能為城市應急管理部門在救護站點佈局、高層建築急救響應標準制訂等方面，提供更具實務參考價值的量化決策依據。

papers.title: Dissociable individuals' neural responses to morality and competence evaluations during the anticipatory and consummatory stages.
papers.abstract: Previous studies have shown that individuals assign differential weight to morality versus competence during feedback processing. However, these studies failed to disentangle the anticipatory and consummatory stages from feedback processing. Therefore, using event-related potentials, the current study adapted an effort-based prosocial task to explore individuals' neural response to morality and competence evaluations in both the anticipatory and consummatory stages. Behaviorally, an interaction effect between evaluation valence and evaluation dimension showed that competence evaluations were rated as more negative than morality evaluations when evaluations were negative, while competence evaluations were rated as more arousing than morality evaluations when evaluations were positive. The ERP results revealed that, during the anticipatory stage, the Cue-P3 was larger when participants received competence cues relative to morality cues in positive contexts. Conversely, the SPN was larger after receiving morality cues compared to competence cues in positive contexts. In the consummatory stages, the LPP was larger for morality evaluations compared to competence evaluations, regardless of positive or negative evaluations. In conclusion, these results provide evidence for a dissociable effect between morality and competence evaluations during both anticipatory and consummatory stages.
papers.summary: 本研究利用事件相關電位（ERP）與基於努力的親社會任務，探討個體在預期與消費階段對道德與能力評估的神經反應。行為結果顯示，負面能力評估比負面道德評估更為負面，而正面能力評估則比正面道德評估更具激動性。ERP結果表明，在預期階段的正面情境下，能力線索引發較大的Cue-P3，而道德線索引發較大的SPN；在消費階段，無論評估正負，道德評估皆引發較大的LPP。這證實了道德與能力評估在兩個階段具有可分離的效應。
papers.significance: 該研究首次成功拆解了反饋處理中的預期與消費階段，揭示了人類大腦處理道德與能力評估時的獨立神經機制。此發現不僅豐富了社會認知神經科學的理論基礎，對於理解個體在社會互動與決策過程中如何賦予不同維度不同權重，亦提供了精確的電生理學證據。

papers.title: Individual differences in lexical decision speed for Chinese single-character words are predicted by ND250 peak latency.
papers.abstract: Reading is a fundamental cognitive skill in modern society that relies on the rapid recognition of visual word forms. Event-related potentials (ERPs) provide a powerful tool for investigating the neural dynamics underlying visual word recognition. Establishing neural-behavior relationships is crucial for characterizing the neural mechanisms underlying specific aspects of behavior. The present study examined whether individual differences in lexical decision speed are associated with the temporal dynamics of the ND250-an ERP component reflecting neural differentiation between real words and pseudowords (or between high- and low-frequency words). Eighty-eight native Chinese readers performed a lexical decision task on real and pseudo Chinese characters while electroencephalographic (EEG) activity was recorded. All real characters used as stimuli were monomorphemic single-character words. Consistent with previous research, pseudo-characters elicited a robust ND250 over occipito-temporal scalp regions, with source estimates localized to the fusiform gyrus. Critically, ND250 peak latency showed a strong positive correlation with reaction times across participants: individuals with earlier ND250 peaks responded faster in the lexical decision task. Hierarchical regression analyses further demonstrated that ND250 latency uniquely predicted lexical decision speed even when earlier (N170) and later (PD300) ERP components were included as predictors. This relationship was consistently observed for both simple and complex characters. Together, these findings suggest that the ND250 serves as an important neurophysiological marker of orthographic processing and represents a key neural mechanism underlying individual differences in the speed of recognizing written words.
papers.summary: 本研究探討中文單字詞彙判斷速度的個體差異與大腦事件相關電位（ERP）成分ND250之間的關聯。針對88名中文母語者進行詞彙判斷任務與腦電圖記錄，結果發現假字在枕顳區誘發了穩健的ND250反應，且訊號源定位於梭狀回。關鍵結果顯示，ND250的峰值潛伏期與受試者的反應時間呈顯著正相關，即ND250峰值出現越早的個體，其詞彙判斷速度越快。即使控制了較早（N170）與較晚（PD300）的ERP成分，ND250潛伏期仍能獨特預測詞彙判斷速度，且此關聯在簡繁字體中皆成立。
papers.significance: 此研究確立了ND250作為正字法處理重要神經生理指標的地位，揭示了書寫文字辨識速度個體差異的關鍵神經機制。這不僅深化了對大腦視覺詞彙識別動態過程的理解，也為未來利用神經指標來預測或評估個體的閱讀認知能力提供了強而有力的實證基礎。

papers.title: Altered neurophysiological processing of social rewards in borderline personality disorder: Insights from a social media paradigm.
papers.abstract: Individuals with Borderline Personality Disorder (BPD) have difficulty forming and maintaining relationships and may turn to social media to compensate for their lack of natural social rewards. However, despite evidence of increased social media use in this population, research has yet to explore how individuals with BPD respond to social media-based rewards at the neurophysiological level. To address this, we recorded EEG from 21 BPD patients and 23 age- and gender-matched healthy controls (HC) as they engaged in a novel paradigm in which they received performance-dependent Likes and positive and negative comments on their own Instagram photos. At a behavioral level, BPD patients rated both Likes and positive comments on their photos as less pleasant than healthy controls. At a neural level, Reward Positivity (RewP) amplitudes elicited by the receipt vs. omission of positive feedback did not differ between groups. However, they were robustly correlated with borderline traits within the BPD group, such that patients with more pronounced traits showed a blunted RewP response to positive feedback, which could contribute to their difficulty in deriving pleasure from social rewards. Notably, the association between borderline traits and RewP in the BPD group was weakened when controlling for co-occurring psychopathology, suggesting that broader affective distress may contribute to this relationship. While future studies are warranted to isolate BPD-specific alterations, current findings provide novel insights into the neural mechanisms that may underlie social dysfunction in BPD.
papers.summary: 本研究探討邊緣型人格障礙（BPD）患者對社交媒體獎勵的神經生理反應。研究記錄了21名BPD患者與23名健康控制組在Instagram範式中收到按讚與評論時的腦電圖（EEG）。行為層面上，BPD患者對正面回饋的愉悅感評分顯著較低；神經層面上，雖然兩組在獎勵正波（RewP）的整體振幅上無顯著差異，但在BPD組內，較嚴重的邊緣特質與對正面回饋較遲鈍的RewP反應顯著相關，且此關聯在控制共病心理症狀後會減弱。
papers.significance: 此研究首次從神經生理學角度揭示了BPD患者社交功能障礙的潛在機制。研究結果表明，BPD患者難以從社交媒體的正面互動中獲得愉悅感，且這種獎勵處理缺陷與其邊緣特質的嚴重程度及廣泛的情感困擾有關。這不僅為理解BPD患者的社交媒體使用行為提供了神經科學依據，也為未來區分BPD特異性神經變化與共病影響指明了方向。

papers.title: Neural correlates of metamemory judgments in worry: An ERP study.
papers.abstract: It is known that worry is associated with reduced efficiency in metamemory and metacognitive processes, yet the neural underpinnings of this relationship remain unclear. This study compared event-related potentials (ERP) during judgment of learning (JOL) and feeling of knowing (FOK) judgments in participants with high and low levels of worry. Participants' (N = 51) metamemory judgments were measured within an episodic memory task context. Although recognition memory and relative accuracy were similar between groups, significant differences were observed in metacognitive efficiency and bias. The high-worry (HW) group exhibited significantly lower confidence relative to their actual performance and reduced metacognitive efficiency compared to the low-worry (LW) group. Furthermore, HW group exhibited significantly larger P200 amplitudes compared to the LW group, whereas the LW group showed larger N200 amplitudes during both JOL and FOK judgments. The findings support the view that increased levels of worry are associated with heightened inefficiencies in mental processing and cognitive monitoring.
papers.summary: 本研究透過事件相關電位（ERP）探討擔憂情緒對元記憶判斷的影響。51名受試者在情景記憶任務中進行學習判斷（JOL）與知曉感（FOK）評估。結果顯示，儘管高擔憂組與低擔憂組在再認記憶與相對準確度上無顯著差異，但高擔憂組的信心水準低於實際表現，且元認知效率較差。腦電波方面，高擔憂組在JOL和FOK判斷時呈現較大的P200振幅，而低擔憂組則呈現較大的N200振幅。
papers.significance: 此研究首次從神經生理學角度揭示了擔憂損害元認知監控的腦電機制。P200與N200振幅的差異不僅為「擔憂會導致心智處理與認知監控效率降低」的觀點提供了客觀的生物標記證據，也有助於未來針對焦慮或憂慮相關障礙的認知干預提供神經科學基礎。

papers.title: The impact of a loss of control over threat on stress reactivity.
papers.abstract: Uncontrollable negative events often elicit higher acute anxiety and stress than negative situations within our control. Beyond these immediate effects, some studies showed that experiences of control over negative situations may promote future resilience against stress-related impairments. Conversely, it has been shown that loss of control over threat may be more detrimental than a consistent lack of control. Whether loss of control affects stress reactivity remains poorly understood. The current study investigated the impact of loss of control over a threat on stress reactivity in humans. Eighty participants were equally assigned to either a Continuous Control or a Loss of Control group to perform a threat (un)controllability task in which they either lost or maintained control over aversive electrical stimuli. Subsequently, participants were exposed to an acute stress induction procedure (Socially Evaluated Cold Pressor Test). The experiment included assessments of perceived stress and control, salivary alpha-amylase and cortisol, blood pressure, and electrodermal activity. Additionally, participants completed questionnaires about emotion regulation strategies, general sense of control, and distress tolerance. Our results did not support the prediction that experiencing loss of control over threat heightens biological and perceived stress markers acutely or that it enhances biological reactivity to a subsequent stressor. However, we found that loss of control increased perceived stress in the subsequent task, specifically among females, which may partly reflect sex-specific stimulus duration differences inherent to the used yoking procedure. Further research is necessary to corroborate our findings and to explore the observed sex-specific vulnerability to loss of control.
papers.summary: 本研究探討人類對威脅喪失控制感如何影響壓力反應性。80名參與者被分為「持續控制組」與「喪失控制組」，在經歷威脅（不可）控制任務後，接受急性壓力誘發測試（社會評價冷壓測試），並測量其感知壓力、唾液澱粉酶、皮質醇、血壓及皮膚電活動等生理與心理指標。結果顯示，喪失控制感並未如預期般急性提升生物或感知壓力標記，也未增強對後續壓力源的生理反應性；然而，研究發現喪失控制感會特異性地增加女性在後續任務中的感知壓力。
papers.significance: 此研究挑戰了「喪失控制感會加劇急性生理壓力反應」的傳統假設，揭示了喪失控制感對壓力反應的影響可能不體現在生理層面，而是特異性地增加女性的感知壓力。這為理解控制感在壓力調節中的性別差異提供了新視角，並指出未來研究需謹慎檢視實驗設計（如配對程序）中可能潛在的性別偏差，對完善壓力應對機制與情緒調節理論具有重要參考價值。
